injuries.description: Tenderness and bruising on right knee
source: tenderness and bruising on his right knee.
mild bruising and tenderness over his right knee

injuries.description: Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressive Mood
source: Adjustment Disorder with Mixed Anxiety and Depressive Mood (Code 309.0)
symptoms suggestive of Post-traumatic Stress Disorder (“PTSD”).

manifestations.description: Tenderness and bruising on his right knee
Apprehension / anxiety about work; fear of being attacked
Unable to concentrate on his work
Social withdrawal / loss of social life; appeared rather withdrawn socially
Suicidal idea (noted on presentation to A&E)
Nightmares (less nightmares and occasional flashback reported)

treatments_received.treatment: Attendance and treatment at Accident & Emergency Department of Princess Margaret Hospital; discharged with analgesic
source: he was sent to Princess Margaret Hospital by an ambulance for treatment
he was discharged from the hospital with analgesic on the day of the Assault, according to the medical report of Dr. Chu of the Accident & Emergency Department of Princess Margaret Hospital.

treatments_received.treatment: Admission to Kwai Chung Hospital for management of aggressive behaviour / psychiatric management
source: He was then sent to Kwai Chung Hospital for further management.

treatments_received.treatment: Referral to Li Ka Shing Outpatient Clinic for psychiatric follow-up
source: He was then referred to Li Ka Shing Outpatient Clinic.
he was diagnosed as Adjustment Disorder and would require further psychological treatment.

treatments_received.treatment: Attendance and follow-up at Prince of Wales Hospital psychiatric services and clinical psychologist input
source: He was later referred to Prince of Wales Hospital.
further biweekly follow-up treatment by both psychiatrist and clinical psychologist for six months is considered necessary.

treatments_received.treatment: Consultation at Caritas Medical Centre (CMC) with medication and 3 days' sick leave on one occasion
source: After work he went to Caritas Medical Centre (“CMC”) for treatment. He was given 3 days’ sick leave and he was advised to seek follow-up treatment at Lee Ka Shing Outpatient Clinic with an appointment fixed on 9 June 2010.
In his medical report dated 2 April 2009, Dr Fung of CMC recorded that on 9 February 2009 Johnny Wong complained ... He was given reassurance and discharged with medication.

losses.description: Social life seriously affected; appeared rather withdrawn socially; loss of interest in gatherings

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: He did not want to go anywhere near the Development again; fearful and worried when encountering the defendant
Less willing to work night shift; fearful of being attacked as a security guard; resigned and did not take up gainful employment after resignation

losses.category: Loss of ability to enjoy quiet or solitude
losses.description: Persistent anxiety, uptight state of mind and inability to relax or enjoy previous activities
